title: DStill: Trajectory Consistency Distillation for Accelerated One-Step Drafting in Block Diffusion Speculative Decoding
abstract: arXiv:2610.27379v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Block-diffusion speculative decoding accelerates large language model inference by drafting multiple tokens in parallel. However, one-step drafting in discrete diffusion is limited by token factorization error: each token is predicted from the same masked block, without conditioning on the tokens selected at other positions in that step. This can produce inconsistent drafts and reduce acceptance length. Iterative refinement mitigates this limitation by conditioning later predictions on previously committed tokens, though additional passes increase drafting cost. To address this trade-off between draft fidelity and inference latency, we introduce DStill, a two-stage framework that distills a target-conditioned drafter's own multi-step refinement into one-step drafting. We first train the drafter to complete partially revealed blocks, then use its refinement trajectories to train a student to predict the final completion in one pass. Using

translated_title: DStill：面向块扩散投机解码中加速单步草稿生成的轨迹一致性蒸馏
translated_abstract: 块扩散投机解码通过并行起草多个token来加速大语言模型推理。然而，离散扩散中的单步草稿生成受到token因子化误差的限制：每个token都是从同一个掩码块中预测得到的，而没有以该步骤中其他位置所选token作为条件。这会产生不一致的草稿并降低接受长度。迭代细化通过让后续预测以先前已确定的token为条件来缓解这一局限，但额外的推理过程会增加草稿生成成本。为解决草稿保真度与推理延迟之间的权衡，我们提出了DStill，这是一个两阶段框架，将目标条件化草稿器自身的多步细化过程蒸馏为单步草稿生成。我们首先训练草稿器完成部分揭示的块，然后利用其细化轨迹来训练学生模型在单次推理中预测最终完成结果。使用……
tldr: 提出DStill两阶段蒸馏框架，通过轨迹一致性蒸馏将块扩散投机解码中草稿器的多步迭代细化压缩为单步草稿生成，在降低推理延迟的同时保持草稿的保真度。
en_tdlr: DStill is a two-stage framework that distills a target-conditioned drafter's multi-step refinement trajectories into one-step drafting via trajectory consistency distillation, mitigating token factorization error in block diffusion speculative decoding while balancing draft fidelity and inference latency.
